thread:
Maria J: saw a new postmortem summary — recurring ghost residency spikes on the shard pool last week. adding a quick action sync here so we don't lose it.
Samir: +1. I ran a short pprof yesterday; saw long-lived allocations pinned to `ShardCache::entry` paths, allocation stack looks like a retained pointer from async flush.
Priya: can you paste the stack? also, were these nodes on 48GB or 96GB instances?
Samir: nodes were mixed; majority on 48GB. stack snippet:
```
net::io::read -> shard::cache::insert_retained -> runtime::async_flush -> kv::put
```
Jon: that pattern matches the "flush callback closure retaining entire segment" bug we patched in july — but we reverted the patch in the canary. could be regression.
Maria J: ok, action items proposal:
  - Samir: produce a pprof + heap diff with object backtraces pinned (due EOD Fri)
  - Priya: add ephemeral soft-limit alert on shard-residency > 75% of physical mem (1d)
  - Jon: validate the july patch in a unit + integration matrix and re-run canary (3d)
  - ops-oncall: add a runbook step to snapshot /proc/pid/smaps when alert fires (immediate)
Samir: noted. I'll also add flamegraph for async tasks and export .pprof to S3 path `s3://redwood-debug/ghost-residency/3625/`
Priya: for the soft-limit alert, suggested thresholds: warning at 65%, critical at 80%, and a 10m aggregation window. we don't want noisy alerts during GC churn.
ops-oncall: +1 on thresholds. I'll implement the smaps snapshot and a link to an automated uploader in the alert.
Jon: regarding GC, we should test a conservative incremental sweep and a tuned slab reclamation param. I'll spin a testbuild with `--slab-reclaim-ms=50` and `--gc-incremental=true` (branch: patch/reclaim-tune).
Maria J: can we also add a short repro harness that continuously inserts lots of small keys and then issues random deletes to surface fragmentation? that's been our most reliable stress test.
Samir: I'll adapt the existing kv-stress binary. quick command to repro locally:
```
./kv-stress --workers=24 --put-ratio=0.7 --key-size=64 --value-size=1k --duration=20m
```
Priya: assign owners in the postmortem checklist please. also add a metric to rollout dashboard: `shard_resident_bytes / node_physical_bytes` and a 90th percentile over 5m.
Maria J: owners assigned in my PR comments. timeline: heap diffs by Fri, soft-alert live Tue, canary validation Wed-Thu, final patch deploy next Tue (tentative). adjust if blockers.
infra-bot: reminder: CI job `kv-nightly-stress` scheduled to run nightly at 02:00 UTC.
Samir: thanks infra-bot :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: I'll add a short incident play note linking to the repro and who to ping: @Samir, @Jon, @Priya, @Maria J. Also will create a follow-up doc in docs/ops/playbooks.
Maria J: cool. quick check — any objections to adding a short-term eviction policy change to beable aggressive shard trimming under memory pressure? we should keep it behind a feature flag.
Jon: fine with feature flag. risk: may surface more 5xx if trimming races with inflight reads, so limit to canary first.
Priya: I'll schedule a retrospective check-in 2 weeks after deploy to review recurrence metrics and tweak thresholds.
Maria J: thanks everyone — I'll update the postmortem with these action items and close the loop once owners mark done. :eyes:
